newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenia's Cetis to debut on main bourse on Feb 28.
newsitem.headline: Slovenia's Cetis to debut on main bourse on Feb 28.

text.p: Slovenian graphic company Cetis d.d. will list its shares on the first section of the Ljubljana Stock Exchange on February 28, the bourse said on Monday.
The company will list 190,746 ordinary shares with a nominal value of 12,000 tolars ($7.8) each, representing 84.3 percent of its equity.
Cetis said it expects 1996 net profit to fall to around 70 million tolars ($454,545) from 94.8 million in 1995.

"In 1996 we invested some three million marks ($1.8 million), mainly in the modernisation and computerisation of our production and education of our workers," Drago Polak, general manager of Cetis, told Reuters.
Cetis plans to invest the same amount in 1997, he added.
Cetis joins a batch of 30 companies that have been listed on the main or the over-the-counter (OTC) markets of the Ljubljana bourse since January 1996.
Currently there are 26 shares traded on the main market, and 32 on the OTC.
